title: Basic Optimized
description: If you want good performance with no unnecessary features, just lightly modded vanilla.
body:
# Basic Optimized
**Basic Optimized** is a lightweight Fabric modpack designed for players who want a pure Vanilla experience with a massive performance boost. This pack focuses exclusively on code optimization, removing unnecessary bloat while keeping the gameplay exactly as Mojang intended.

## Why choose Basic Optimized?
* **Maximum Performance:** By utilizing core optimization mods like Sodium and Lithium, you can expect a drastic increase in frames per second (FPS) and much smoother frametimes.
* **The Perfect Foundation:** This pack serves as an excellent **base for your own custom modpacks**. It provides a pre-optimized, stable environment, allowing you to add your favorite content mods without worrying about initial performance tuning.
* **Pure Vanilla Experience:** Perfect for survival servers or technical play where gameplay-altering mods are not allowed.
* **Minimalist Design:** No flashy menus or unnecessary features—just a clean, fast, and stable game.

## Performance Benchmarks
This modpack has been stress-tested in a multiplayer environment on the **ogulnie.ga** server. On a system featuring an **AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D** and an **RTX 5060 Ti**, the pack consistently maintains over **400 FPS** with unlimited frame rates and low memory overhead.

## Key Features
* **Rendering Optimization:** Uses modern graphics engines to replace the standard Minecraft renderer for better hardware utilization.
* **Logic & Engine Tweaks:** Optimizes server ticks and background calculations to keep the game responsive.
* **Universal Compatibility:** Designed to be stable across popular game versions without risking corruption of your existing worlds.
